act_title: The Government of Union Territories Act, 1963
title: Oath or affirmation by members.―Every member of the Legislative Assembly of** [1][the Union
text:
11. Oath or affirmation by members.―Every member of the Legislative Assembly of [the Union

territory] shall, before taking his seat, make and subscribe before the Administrator, or some person
appointed in that behalf by him, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the
First Schedule.
